interboard.connector: FX8C-80P-SV1(92) / FX8C-80S-SV5(92), straight SMT, 80 contacts, 11-mm working gap
interboard.why_not_20_or_60: The current 4.25-A step envelope receives fourteen parallel 3V3_MAIN contacts and fourteen primary return contacts, leaving 0.304 A per power contact versus the 0.4-A rating before H3/H5 thermal proof. After two AON contacts, signal-reference returns and 25 live signals, a 60-contact pair has no controlled reserve; 80 is the smallest current FX8C size that preserves both derating and fourteen NC contacts.
interboard.video: K331 remains rear-local; one 75-ohm FPV_CVBS net crosses M1 beside a dedicated return. TVP5150 and all eight data lines plus PCLK/VSYNC/HREF remain UI-local beside S3.
interboard.mechanical_load_path: M1 is electrical/alignment only. Four 11.00-mm compression stops, two anti-shear enclosure datums and independent front/rear PCB capture lips constrain the boards when one screw is loose; no drop, installation or enclosure-bending load is accepted through the SMT joints.
interboard.result: R2 uses 25 live signals, fourteen 3V3_MAIN contacts, twenty-five defined returns, two AON contacts and fourteen true NC reserve contacts; no obsolete audio or M5 signal remains assigned.

display.interface: dedicated direct i8080-8 (Intel 8080) on S3 LCD_CAM TX with GDMA; D0..D7, WR and DC are direct, CS is hard-low because the bus is exclusive, RD is hard-high, IM[2:0]=111, reset remains on the local slow-I/O output, and front Hub captures TE plus drives reset-off backlight PWM
display.controller_limit_basis: ST77922 preliminary v0.1 table 7.4.1 specifies a 26-ns minimum 8080 write cycle and 13-ns minimum WR high/low widths; 32 MHz gives a 31.25-ns cycle and 15.625-ns half-period.
display.s3_supported_sources: ESP32-S3 LCD_CAM has separate LCD TX and camera RX control units, supports simultaneous external LCD and camera connection, an 8-bit i8080 output and GDMA. The selected 32-MHz write clock is below both the S3 8-bit-i80 guidance and ST77922 timing limit.
display.video_window: 320x240 RGB565 at 30 fps is 4.608 MB/s and 14.4% of the selected i8080 payload
display.gpio_closure: All 33 exposed S3 GPIO are assigned: 11 camera RX, 10 direct i8080 outputs, 5 chip-select-free S3-Hub quad data/clock, 2 UI I2C, 2 USB, 2 encoder and 1 wired-OR UI/Hub alert. TE and backlight PWM consume Hub GPIO45/46 instead of S3 pins.
display.fallback: The same 40-contact HMX035CTFT-001 tail still exposes the former QSPI contacts. A build-option QSPI strap/zero-ohm population is retained only as first-prototype recovery if simultaneous LCD_CAM TX/RX or the i8080 timing gate fails; it is not the preferred production interface.
display.maximality_result: Direct i8080-8 is 1.6x faster than the previous legal 40-MHz QSPI wire rate without adding a processor, moving buttons off S3 or sharing display traffic with storage/radio IPC.
display.hil: Before fabrication, compile and run the simultaneous LCD_TX/CAM_RX DMA harness on the emulator-supported register model. H5 then proves ST77922 IM straps, 32-MHz edges, TE timestamp latency, full-frame/dirty-region timing and live BT.656 capture; 36 MHz is measurement-only and never assumed.

fpv.rf: replaceable exact serial analog 5.8-GHz receiver module; generic RX5808 is evidence input, not an accepted MPN
fpv.external_connector: MMCX, DC to at least 6 GHz, user-facing and labelled FPV RX 5.8G
fpv.decoder: Texas Instruments TVP5150AM1PBS or industrial-temperature TVP5150AM1IPBS after factory-route confirmation
fpv.capture: Rear K331 CVBS crosses one M1 signal beside ground into UI-local TVP5150; its 8-bit YUV422 plus PCLK/VSYNC/HREF enters the independent S3 LCD_CAM camera RX/GDMA path while the LCD TX unit drives i8080 concurrently
fpv.first_acceptance_mode: NTSC/PAL source to centered 320x240 live view at source frame rate with UI overlay/remaining portrait area; uncompressed full-source recording is not promised
fpv.coexistence: Entering FPV mode powers the receiver/decoder group, disables C5 5-GHz RF and all unused transmit groups, and preserves the one-active-signal-group rule.
fpv.power_thermal_gate: Receiver, decoder, regulator and local shielding are added to the unattended thermal and battery budgets before H1 acceptance.

airband.signal_group: BROADCAST_RX remains the exclusive top-level receive group; FM, SW, AM/LW and AIR are mutually exclusive submodes
airband.i2c: SI5351A-B-GTR joins the isolated rear-RP-local I2C bus at address 0x60; it does not share S3 UI I2C
airband.gp35: AIR_RX_EN is pulled low and removes the Airband RF/LO domain when unused
airband.gp36: AIR_RX_MODE defaults to the direct FM/SW path before rear-RP firmware starts

power.r1_status: The reviewed R1 2.493-A worst state and 2.5-A continuous rail are historical only because R2 adds an always-present Hub RP plus FPV and Airband domains.

airband_increment.rail: switched low-noise 3.0-V RF domain plus Hub-local 3.3-V control
airband_increment.basis: PGA-103+ 60 mA at 3 V; LT5560 up to 12 mA at 3 V; SI5351 core plus one output up to 40.6 mA; selector/control/filter margin included

power.coexistence: FPV and Airband are never powered together; both remain mutually exclusive with unused transmit groups under the one-active-signal-group rule.
